name: Mizuiro no Chizu
source:
Hero is a police officer. At his workplace he meets a variety of girls. Most of them have a mystery aura around them. He wants to protect them and to know more about them, so he leans to them... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名警察，在工作场所结识了形形色色的女孩。她们大多笼罩着神秘气息。主人公想保护她们，也想进一步了解她们，于是渐渐为她们所吸引……

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
